items.claim: Draws a test read from its group (`from: 'group'`) with its comparison and value controls, names its pref as the group's, and keeps it reading the group through edits
A `readout` number pref's compared value is drawn read-only
items.note: The value field no longer takes the pref's `readOnly` or its `onClear`. A said a clear button shows; that is not a defect: `onClear` here is what happens when the field is emptied, and no button is drawn.

items.claim: The clipboard's status message never clears
items.note: It now shows only while the condition is the one it was said about.

items.claim: A refused clipboard read is reported as "holds no condition" (A, part of the finding above)
items.note: It now says "The clipboard could not be read."

items.claim: A malformed condition gets no Paste
Rows keyed by index hand a removed row's state to the next row
items.note: Every control in a row takes its value from the row. The only state a row keeps for itself is a number being typed or an open list, and the blur or press it takes to reach another row's Remove commits or closes it first. Inferred from reading the code, not run.

items.claim: `exclude` never reaches an entry's own fields
items.note: A path through an entry (`phases.*.mode`) now also leaves out the entry field it names after its last `*`, and the `exclude` doc says so.
